proposal.hypothesis: Assigning one CTA to each target row and striding its threads over source indices exposes row-level CTA parallelism while reducing the per-thread serial source loop. Warp shuffles and a small shared-memory reduction combine the force components; changing items_per_block to 1 requests one CTA per row. This is a performance hypothesis, not a measured result.

retained: Changed the launch mapping to one 256-thread CTA per target row by setting items_per_block to 1.
Distributed source indices across CTA threads with a blockDim.x stride, skipping self-interactions and guarding the n tail.
Reduced per-thread force sums within each warp using shuffle-down operations, then reduced eight warp sums through shared memory and warp 0.
